svg.title: Arda Çabuk
svg.desc: An ASCII night meadow: grass bends in gusts of wind, two wind turbines turn on a hill, fireflies drift and stars twinkle. A signpost in the grass reads ARDA ÇABUK, pointing left to embedded and C/C++ and right to machine learning. A terminal line at the bottom monitors the turbine.

g.text: A R D A Ç A B U K
